Visited petworld Tallaght today to purchase some goldfish for my 2 boys. I had rang prior to my visit and spoke with Molly. She was so helpful and friendly. We then purchased what we needed and now I have 2 very happy boys. After visiting 2 other shops with no help, Petworld was great and would recommend

I visited Petworld in Tallaght today with my two dogs (Babies), Mila and Milo, mainly to get them out of the house because the rain was so bad — and I’m so glad we did!
The store has a fantastic selection of food and treats, and they run great 3-for-2 offers on lots of items, which is always a bonus. We went in to get Milo a new harness. Milo can be quite anxious and a bit nervous at times, but the staff were honestly amazing with him.
They were so kind and patient — asking Mila and Milo their names, chatting away to them, and gently helping me try multiple harnesses on Milo to make sure we got the right fit. They were so calm and reassuring with him, which made such a difference. Even though we didn’t end up buying a harness (we just couldn’t get the perfect size), their help and attitude were outstanding.
We left with plenty of treats instead, and the dogs (babies) genuinely seemed to love the shop. It’s such a welcoming, dog-friendly place with brilliant staff. We’ll definitely be back

Great shop, great staff, great prices.. 4* because I bought 6 "siamese algae eaters" here which turned out to not actually be siamese but golden Chinese algae eaters. Completely different fish. Dangerous fish to have in a community tank. I have them in my 350l and it's literally impossible to catch them and get them out. They're very aggressive and destructive fish. I would recommend changing the name on the tank..
